items.exampleEn: Many students wrote reports about deforestation for their science class.
items.exampleZh: 許多學生為自然課寫了關於森林砍伐的報告。

items.exampleEn: Each zebra has its own pattern of black and white stripes.
items.exampleZh: 每一匹斑馬都有自己獨特的黑白條紋。

items.exampleEn: A tiny sparrow flew into the classroom through an open window.
items.exampleZh: 一隻小麻雀從開著的窗戶飛進教室。

items.exampleEn: Farmers in this valley grow hemp for making rope.
items.exampleZh: 這座山谷的農夫種麻來做繩子。

items.exampleEn: It was a breezy afternoon, perfect for flying a kite.
items.exampleZh: 那是個有微風的下午，很適合放風箏。

items.exampleEn: A young kangaroo stays close to its mother for many months.
items.exampleZh: 小袋鼠會在母親身邊待上好幾個月。

items.exampleEn: The children blew the seeds off a dandelion and watched them fly away.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把蒲公英的種子吹散，看著它們飛走。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather checks the barometer on the wall every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺每天早上都會看牆上的氣壓計。

items.sentenceEn: The weather will be dry and breezy along the coast tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 明天沿海地區的天氣乾燥、有微風。

items.audioEn: The barometer is falling fast, so we should expect rain before evening.
items.audioZh: 氣壓計下降得很快，所以傍晚前應該會下雨。
items.questionZh: 說話者預期會有什麼天氣？

items.sentenceEn: Zebras and other animals walk long distances to find water.
items.sentenceZh: 斑馬和其他動物會走很遠的路去找水。

items.sentenceEn: Dandelions grow almost everywhere, even between the stones of the pavement.
items.sentenceZh: 蒲公英幾乎到處都能生長，連人行道的石塊縫隙裡也有。

items.stemEn: On our drive through the Australian countryside, a wild ____ jumped across the road.
items.stemZh: 我們開車穿越澳洲鄉間時，一隻野生袋鼠跳過了馬路。

items.stemEn: Bring a jacket. It's sunny today, but it's quite ____ by the sea.
items.stemZh: 帶件外套吧。今天雖然出太陽，但海邊風蠻大的。

items.passageEn: Our town opened a small nature center last year. Inside, a large map shows how deforestation has changed the hills around us over the past fifty years. Visitors can also see an old barometer that farmers once used to predict storms. Outside, there is a garden full of wild plants, and many species of birds, especially sparrows, come to feed there. The gift shop sells bags made of hemp, a strong plant fiber. My favorite part is the path behind the center, where dandelions cover the ground every spring.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上去年開了一間小型自然中心。館內有一張大地圖，呈現過去五十年來森林砍伐如何改變我們周圍的山丘。參觀者也可以看到一個舊氣壓計，以前農夫用它來預測暴風雨。館外有一座長滿野生植物的花園，許多種鳥類會來這裡覓食，尤其是麻雀。禮品店賣用麻做的袋子，麻是一種很堅韌的植物纖維。我最喜歡的是中心後面的小路，每年春天蒲公英都會鋪滿地面。

questions.questionZh: 館內的大地圖呈現什麼？
options: 全鎮各條健行步道的位置
各種候鳥每年的遷徙路線
砍伐森林對山丘的影響

items.promptZh: 這一帶的森林砍伐讓許多鳥失去了家。
referenceEn: Deforestation in this area has made many birds lose their homes.
Because of deforestation in this area, many birds have lost their homes.
rubricZh: 要用 deforestation 當名詞（例如 deforestation in this area）
「失去了家」可寫，例如 lose their homes、have lost their homes 等
時態合理即可（例如 has made、caused）

items.instructionZh: 用 breezy 造一個句子，描述某個地方或某個季節的天氣。
referenceEn: My hometown is cool and breezy in the autumn.
I like to sit on my balcony on breezy summer evenings.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 breezy（例如 breezy evenings、is breezy）
breezy 是形容詞，位置例如放在名詞前（breezy evenings）、放在 be 動詞後（is breezy）等都可以
